evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/t/e extends MouseAdapter, owns only one TradingPostListingPanel, and on left-button mousePressed invokes the panel's reviewed click/action path.
The same adapter handles mouseEntered/mouseExited by switching the panel-owned JPanel between the exact Trading Post hover and normal theme colors.
No unrelated exact-v308 consumer survives; the adapter is constructed and retained only by TradingPostListingPanel inside the reviewed Trading Post subsystem.

candidates.note: TradingPostListingInteractionListener is a descriptive exact-behavior name for the panel-owned click/hover adapter. It does not claim a verbatim original anonymous-class identifier.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/t/n extends MouseAdapter, owns one TradingPostSearchResultPanel plus its JPanel list and base Color, and changes every listed panel to the exact hover color on mouseEntered.
On mouseEntered it sets the reviewed search-result panel cursor to HAND_CURSOR (12); on mouseExited it restores every listed JPanel to the captured base color and resets DEFAULT_CURSOR (0).
mouseReleased is intentionally empty and no unrelated exact-v308 consumer survives; the class is a bounded hover/cursor adapter for TradingPostSearchResultPanel.

candidates.note: TradingPostSearchResultHoverListener is a descriptive exact-behavior name. It does not claim a verbatim original anonymous-class identifier.
